title: Localized tensor comparison closure: fixed degree
statement: For the same rings, complexes, flatness and cocone as the coproduct closure statement, fix a representative U of the coproduct vertex S, a chosen derived model mU for U tensor Q, and a degree i. If every summand satisfies the localized tensor comparison predicate, then the localized comparison map for mU in degree i, followed by the canonical associator and t map, is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives of the summands, form their coproduct, and identify all tensor, scalar-extension and homology maps with coproducts. The direct sum of the summand isomorphisms is an isomorphism; transport through the coproduct cocone, representative isomorphism and model comparison to the fixed U, mU and i.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJA(1), coproducts part of the localizing argument; model identification by the universal counit and Tag 0BYJ

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_closure_coproducts_fixed_degree
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    {I : Type u} (G : I → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (S : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (ι : ∀ i, G i ⟶ S)
    (hc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.mk S ι))
    (hs : ∀ i, localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t (G i))
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (e : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ S))
    (hU : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)
